name: 課題ひな型の本文と既定プロパティを設定する作成フォーム
prompt:
Create one faithful static Linear issue-template form screenshot at exactly 950x610 px, matching the supplied crop. Use a white canvas, restrained light-gray borders, compact neutral UI typography, and precise alignment. Show only the template editor area; no application navigation, browser frame, modal backdrop, or extra content.

At the top left, show a small outlined document icon followed by the light-gray placeholder 「テンプレート名」. Under it, show the single-line light-gray optional-description placeholder 「テンプレートの説明（任意）を追加...」.

Below, include one large rounded rectangular issue-body area with a fine light-gray outline. Inside its upper-left corner, show the large light-gray placeholder 「課題のタイトル」 and beneath it the smaller placeholder 「説明を追加...」. Leave the rest of this body blank.

Below the body, add the section heading 「既定のプロパティ」 and the supporting sentence 「課題作成時に自動適用され、Linearで作成中に編集できます」. Under that, create one wide rounded light-outline property bar with five compact inline controls in this order: small team icon + 「チーム」; priority glyph + 「優先度」; assignee/person icon + 「担当者」; project cube icon + 「プロジェクト」; label/tag icon + 「ラベル」; then a small ellipsis menu. Keep them aligned on one line with generous unused space to the right.

At the bottom right, show an outlined white button 「キャンセル」 and a filled muted blue-violet primary button 「作成」. Match source spacing: ample gap below the property bar, controls aligned to the same baseline, and buttons close together. Keep all text and controls fully visible and unclipped. Use source-like pale placeholders, dark section labels, thin borders, and subtle radius. Do not invent data, extra fields, tags, or active menu content.
reviewNotes: Needs correction. The first pass includes all fields and controls but places the issue body and default-properties area about 10-15 px below the source at target size. The second prompt specifies the source anchors and produces a closer layout.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
